import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}; os.makedirs("/tmp/st",exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,o): open(o,"wb").write(requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=180).content)
for pid in ["8E1M","9N84","6LO8","7CGP"]: dl(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif", f"/tmp/st/{pid}.cif")
dl("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9NPL8-F1-model_v6.pdb","/tmp/st/TIMMDC1_AF.pdb")

def parse_cif(path):
    lines=open(path).read().splitlines(); rows=[]; cols=None; i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith("loop_"):
            hdr=[]; j=i+1
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith("_"): hdr.append(lines[j].strip()); j+=1
            if hdr and hdr[0].startswith("_atom_site."):
                cols=[h.split(".")[1] for h in hdr]; k=j
                while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith("#"):
                    p=lines[k].split()
                    if len(p)==len(cols): rows.append(p)
                    k+=1
                i=k; continue
            i=j; continue
        i+=1
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
def parse_pdb(path):
    recs=[]
    for L in open(path):
        if L.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            recs.append(dict(group_PDB=L[:6].strip(),label_atom_id=L[12:16].strip(),label_comp_id=L[17:20].strip(),
             auth_asym_id=L[21].strip(),auth_seq_id=L[22:26].strip(),Cartn_x=L[30:38],Cartn_y=L[38:46],
             Cartn_z=L[46:54],B_iso_or_equiv=L[60:66],type_symbol=L[76:78].strip()))
    return pd.DataFrame(recs)
def clean(df):
    d=df.copy()
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: d[c]=d[c].astype(float)
    d["auth_seq_id"]=pd.to_numeric(d["auth_seq_id"],errors="coerce")
    d["B_iso_or_equiv"]=pd.to_numeric(d["B_iso_or_equiv"],errors="coerce")
    return d
S={p:clean(parse_cif(f"/tmp/st/{p}.cif")) for p in ["8E1M","9N84","6LO8","7CGP"]}
S["TIMMDC1"]=clean(parse_pdb("/tmp/st/TIMMDC1_AF.pdb"))
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def chain_atoms(key,chain,lo=None,hi=None):
    d=S[key]; d=d[(d.auth_asym_id==chain)&(d.label_comp_id.isin(t2o))&(d.group_PDB=="ATOM")]
    d=d[~d.label_atom_id.str.startswith("H")]
    if lo is not None: d=d[(d.auth_seq_id>=lo)&(d.auth_seq_id<=hi)]
    return d
def ca_of(d):
    c=d[d.label_atom_id=="CA"].drop_duplicates("auth_seq_id").sort_values("auth_seq_id")
    return (c[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float), c.auth_seq_id.values.astype(int),
            "".join(t2o[r] for r in c.label_comp_id))
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); V,_,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt; return R,qc-pc@R
def ap(P,R,t): return P@R+t
def refine(P,Q,pairs,d0,Ln):
    idx=np.array(pairs); A=P[idx[:,0]]; B=Q[idx[:,1]]; R,t=kabsch(A,B)
    for _ in range(20):
        d=np.linalg.norm(ap(A,R,t)-B,axis=1); sel=d<max(d0,3.5)
        if sel.sum()<4:
            o=np.argsort(d)[:max(4,len(d)//4)]; sel=np.zeros(len(d),bool); sel[o]=True
        R2,t2=kabsch(A[sel],B[sel])
        if np.allclose(R2,R,atol=1e-7): break
        R,t=R2,t2
    d=np.linalg.norm(ap(A,R,t)-B,axis=1)
    return float((1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/Ln),(R,t)
def dp(score,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=score.shape; prev=[0.0]*(m+1); ptr=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; sl=score.tolist()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cur=[0.0]*(m+1); row=sl[i-1]; pr=ptr[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=prev[j-1]+row[j-1]; b=prev[j]+gap; c=cur[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: cur[j]=a; pr[j]=0
            elif b>=c: cur[j]=b; pr[j]=1
            else: cur[j]=c; pr[j]=2
        prev=cur
    i,j=n,m; out=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=ptr[i][j]
        if k==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return out[::-1]
def tmalign(P,Q,topk=8,iters=8):
    n,m=len(P),len(Q); L=min(n,m); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5); seeds=[]
    for off in range(-(n-10),m-9):
        pr=[(i,i+off) for i in range(n) if 0<=i+off<m]
        if len(pr)>=10: seeds.append(pr)
    sc=sorted(((refine(P,Q,s,d0,L)[0],s) for s in seeds),key=lambda x:-x[0]); best=(0,None,None)
    for _,sd in sc[:topk]:
        pairs=sd
        for _ in range(iters):
            tm,(R,t)=refine(P,Q,pairs,d0,L)
            D=np.linalg.norm(ap(P,R,t)[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2)
            newp=dp(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if len(newp)<4: break
            tm2,Rt2=refine(P,Q,newp,d0,L)
            if tm2>best[0]: best=(tm2,newp,Rt2)
            if newp==pairs: break
            pairs=newp
    tm,pairs,(R,t)=best
    return dict(tm=tm,pairs=pairs,R=R,t=t)

refat=chain_atoms("9N84","A"); refP,refI,refS=ca_of(refat)
st=S["9N84"]; STEN=st[st.auth_asym_id=="D"][["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float)

targets={"Tim17 yeast (8E1M)":chain_atoms("8E1M","A"),
         "Tim17 yeast +stendo (9N84)":refat,
         "Tim23 yeast (8E1M)":chain_atoms("8E1M","B"),
         "Tim22 yeast (6LO8)":chain_atoms("6LO8","A"),
         "Tim22 human (7CGP)":chain_atoms("7CGP","A"),
         "TIMMDC1 human (AF)":chain_atoms("TIMMDC1","A",80,230)}

# grid over the stendomycin-occupied site, in the 9N84 Tim17 frame
lo=STEN.min(0)-4; hi=STEN.max(0)+4; step=0.8
gx,gy,gz=[np.arange(lo[i],hi[i],step) for i in range(3)]
G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(gx,gy,gz,indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)
dsten=np.sqrt(((G[:,None,:]-STEN[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)
site=G[dsten<4.5]            # the volume occupied/contacted by the topogenic-sequence mimic
print("site grid points:", len(site), "site volume (A^3):", round(len(site)*step**3,1))

rows=[]
for name,at in targets.items():
    P,I,Sq=ca_of(at); r=tmalign(P,refP); R,t=r["R"],r["t"]
    xyz=ap(at[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float),R,t)
    elem=at.label_atom_id.str[0].values
    D=np.sqrt(((site[:,None,:]-xyz[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
    nearest=D.argmin(1); dmin=D.min(1)
    free = dmin>3.0                               # grid point not occupied by protein
    vol  = free.sum()*step**3
    lin  = (dmin>3.0)&(dmin<5.0)                  # shell lining the free volume
    lining_atoms=np.unique(nearest[lin])
    pol = np.isin(elem[lining_atoms],["N","O"]).mean() if len(lining_atoms) else np.nan
    # charged side-chain atoms lining
    sub=at.iloc[lining_atoms]
    chg = sub[(sub.label_comp_id.isin(["ASP","GLU"])&sub.label_atom_id.isin(["OD1","OD2","OE1","OE2","CG","CD"]))|
              (sub.label_comp_id.isin(["LYS","ARG"])&sub.label_atom_id.isin(["NZ","NH1","NH2","NE"]))]
    nac = sub[sub.label_comp_id.isin(["ASP","GLU"])].auth_seq_id.nunique()
    nbc = sub[sub.label_comp_id.isin(["LYS","ARG"])].auth_seq_id.nunique()
    nres= sub.auth_seq_id.nunique()
    rows.append(dict(structure=name, TM_to_Tim17=round(r["tm"],3), free_cavity_volume_A3=round(vol,1),
                     frac_free=round(free.mean(),3), lining_residues=nres,
                     lining_atom_frac_N_O=round(float(pol),3),
                     acidic_lining_res=nac, basic_lining_res=nbc))
    print(rows[-1])
cav=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(); print(cav.to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
o=cav.sort_values("free_cavity_volume_A3")
cols=["#d1495b" if "TIMMDC1" in s else ("#2e86ab" if "Tim17" in s else "#8aa29e") for s in o.structure]
axes[0].barh(o.structure,o.free_cavity_volume_A3,color=cols); axes[0].set_xlabel("free cavity volume at the Tim17 site (A^3)")
axes[0].set_title("Space available for a topogenic helix")
o2=cav.sort_values("lining_atom_frac_N_O")
cols2=["#d1495b" if "TIMMDC1" in s else ("#2e86ab" if "Tim17" in s else "#8aa29e") for s in o2.structure]
axes[1].barh(o2.structure,o2.lining_atom_frac_N_O,color=cols2); axes[1].set_xlabel("fraction of cavity-lining atoms that are N or O")
axes[1].set_title("Hydrophilicity of the cavity lining")
w=0.38; y=np.arange(len(cav))
axes[2].barh(y-w/2,cav.acidic_lining_res,height=w,color="#c1121f",label="Asp/Glu")
axes[2].barh(y+w/2,cav.basic_lining_res,height=w,color="#2b50aa",label="Lys/Arg")
axes[2].set_yticks(y); axes[2].set_yticklabels(cav.structure); axes[2].legend()
axes[2].set_xlabel("charged residues lining the cavity"); axes[2].set_title("Charge of the cavity lining")
for a in axes: a.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
